prompt: Give one tip for better sleep.
response: One effective tip for better sleep is to establish a consistent bedtime routine. This includes activities that help your body relax and prepare for sleep, such as reading a book, taking a warm bath, or practicing gentle stretching. Consistency is key; try to go to bed and wake up at the same time every day, even on weekends. This helps regulate your body's internal clock and can improve the quality of your sleep over time.
